propositions: Removing compaction from the close path left stores without CI and no local cron with no standing compaction trigger, causing event logs to grow unbounded.
The scheduled sweep selects tickets by two arms: backfill (no SNAPSHOT and at least one foldable event) OR recurrence (foldable count exceeds threshold), converging after each fold.
Compaction must also trigger out-of-band on close via O(1) checks and a detached worker with stamped advisory lock, so no adoption is left without a compaction mechanism.
The sweep walks git history per ticket inside the write lock, recreating bug 7084 at scale; history must be batched and hoisted outside the critical section.
Honest counting observes snapshot artifacts before/after to detect successful folds, rather than trusting return codes that cannot distinguish a no-op from work.

The trigger respects sustained writer contention by re-yielding mid-sweep and standing aside when the store lock is held, because compaction is optional housekeeping that must never starve foreground work.
